title: the rendering-architecture half of a smooth High/Ultra: shadow caching, half-res effects, far LODs, no hitches
lensAText: a sceptical rendering engineer. Read /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/wf/brief-smoothcore.md. Look at the builder's before/after frames, timing tables and logs with the Read tool, then build dist/artifact.html yourself and run ONE short Playwright script: a scripted 2-minute Ultra drive with streaming at 1280x720, alternating base/ours, counting frames over 33 ms and heap churn, plus full-quality frames for visual diffs. Judge: same look at full quality; fewer long frames; no new program compiles after warm-up; streaming off the main thread or time-sliced; LODs without visible pop; honest timing claims (SwiftShader relative only). Reject on visible quality loss at full quality, new hitches, or regressions.
